object.name: The Moosehead Lounge
materials: Muted warm masonry — generic material, facade unverified

scene_identity: OpenStreetMap way 910910470; City of West Lafayette BPW map dated 2026-02-19 labels Moosehead Lounge at this location.
excluded_candidate: Assignment-queue FID 855 resolves to Old Purdue Exponent Building; excluded. Purdue campus GIS name query returned no Moosehead record.
footprint_status: OSM way 910910470 at 434 N Grant St agrees with assigned manifest bbox and city named-site map. In the documented local projection, Indiana 2018 polygon 409924 overlaps 228.73 m2 of the OSM outline area (242.12 m2; 94.45%), but the Indiana polygon is 601.70 m2 overall and only 38.01% is shared; it includes adjacent southern roof and is not treated as the exact target footprint.
height_status: Estimated: 5.25 m eave and 7.60 m ridge. No measured height or elevation source found.
roof_status: Two-zone gabled roof silhouette (west/north body and east/south wing) follows visible roof-plane breaks in 2022-2025 Indiana orthophoto and OSM footprint projections. Gable-end wall faces close west and east terminal profiles. Exact roof seam positions, ridge directions, and all heights remain interpreted estimates, not survey measurements.
geometry_iteration: r2: removed unsupported repeated windows, sill bands, and trim; retained only three OSM-mapped level-0 entry positions as schematic plain doors; split broad single roof into west/north and east/south gabled zones; added west/east gable-end wall faces; preserved exact OSM 910910470 structural ring.
facade_detail_status: Only three OSM-tagged level-0 entrance positions are represented as plain schematic doors. No windows, facade rhythm, bands, or trim are claimed because no direct facade photo or elevation was identified.
